name: multimodal safety-defense result rebinding across visual inputs
description: A cached multimodal safety-defense verdict from a prior visual input is rebound to a different later visual input because the cache key omits canonical input identity, so the new item's fresh safety analysis is skipped.
regex: (?is)^(?!.*\b(?:security guide|documentation|unit test|incident report|postmortem|defensive|must not|do not|never)\b)(?=.*\b(?:retrieved memory|memory record|RAG|knowledge[- ]base|cache)\b)(?=.*\b(?:cached|stale|prior|previous)\b)(?=.*\b(?:defen[cs]e|safety)\b)(?=.*\b(?:safe|passed|over[- ]?refusal)\b)(?=.*\b(?:new visual|later visual|different visual|new image|attacker[- ]image|new multimodal)\b)(?=.*\b(?:reuse|rebind|apply|carry|reused|applied)\b)(?=.*\b(?:skip|omit|without|no fresh|no input)\b)(?=.*\b(?:fresh safety|fresh analysis|identity check|input hash|visual analysis|safety analysis)\b).*$
